comment: THE EMBED ABI, WRITTEN DOWN ONCE. Every export and every capability bit is here, and the bindings under bindings/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-abi-bindings.ps1: do not edit them. tools/check-abi-manifest.sh fails when this file, the exports marked [UnmanagedCallersOnly] in src/Host/EmbedApi.cs, the capability bits in src/Host/EmbedCapabilities.cs, or the generated files disagree. `since` IS each entry's minimum ABI: a binding generated from ABI 5 calls an entry only when the library reports at least that revision, and drops the rest.

conventions.handle: int64_t, opaque and never reused (a counter, not a slot): a stale handle answers a refusal naming it instead of reaching a new session. 0 is not a session; it is the calling thread's last slc_create failure, which is what a host reads after slc_create answered 0.
conventions.strings: UTF-8 and NUL-terminated. An input string belongs to the caller and is read only for the duration of the call. An output goes into a CALLER-OWNED buffer with the snprintf convention: the call answers the length it NEEDS excluding the terminator, writes at most capacity - 1 bytes plus the terminator, and answers the same length for capacity 0, so one probe sizes the buffer. Nothing returned points into engine memory.
conventions.statuses: The engine's exit codes, so a host reads the numbers the CLI exits with: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage, 3 refused. A run that ended with the script's own exit(n) answers n. A refusal names its reason in slc_last_error.
conventions.threads: One call at a time per handle: a run is marshalled to the thread that owns the interpreter and the host waits for it, so a second verb arriving meanwhile is refused by name rather than queued. slc_cancel is the exception (a signal from any thread by design). Nothing throws across the boundary.

exports.name: slc_version
exports.summary: the engine version, the runtime and the ABI revision as one sentence, so a host log answers which build answered

exports.name: slc_abi_revision
exports.summary: the ABI revision alone, for a binding that compares a contract instead of parsing a sentence

exports.name: slc_capabilities
exports.summary: the bitmask of what THIS build answers, so a binding drops what an older library lacks instead of failing a lookup

exports.name: slc_create
exports.summary: a session handle, or 0 with the reason in slc_last_error(0, ...)

exports.name: slc_free
exports.summary: 0 released, 2 an unknown or already freed handle, 3 a run is in flight (the handle stays valid, so freeing can be retried)

exports.name: slc_thread_mode
exports.summary: 0 the engine's own thread, 1 the host's, -1 an unknown handle: the two modes have different stack budgets

exports.name: slc_last_error
exports.summary: one sentence about the last call on that handle, or empty when it succeeded; handle 0 answers the calling thread's last slc_create failure

exports.name: slc_last_result
exports.summary: the last run's or call's verdict as JSON (Status, Ok, Error, Fatal, Cancelled, Code, Message, Line, Checks, Result), one door for everything a verb answered

exports.name: slc_stats
exports.summary: a JSON snapshot of the session for a host's own log: revision, capability mask, thread mode, apartment, stack budget, globals

exports.name: slc_set_output
exports.summary: 0 installed a line callback (channel 0 print, 1 engine log), NULL removes it; with none the output is dropped rather than written to the host's console

exports.name: slc_run_file
exports.summary: the run's status: runs source text in the session's interpreter, so what it declares stays callable; a compiled bundle is refused by name

exports.name: slc_run_text
exports.summary: the run's status for source text; the optional name is what Script.Directory() and ./ mean for a snippet

exports.name: slc_adopt
exports.summary: registers the host's own COM object (called on the HOST's thread), so a script reaches the application that loaded the engine with Com.Host()

exports.name: slc_poll
exports.summary: 1 while an asynchronous run is in flight, 0 idle, negative for an unknown handle; the finished run's verdict lands in slc_last_result

exports.name: slc_run_text_async
exports.summary: the same run as slc_run_text, started and not waited for (0 accepted, 2 refused), which is what lets an STA host pump while the script drives it

exports.name: slc_run_file_async
exports.summary: slc_run_file, started and not waited for; the same rules and the same compiled-bundle refusal

exports.name: slc_run_bundle_bytes
exports.summary: the run's status for a compiled bundle held in memory, which is what a packaged executable needs; the run's directory is the session's home

exports.name: slc_main_owns
exports.summary: 1 when the engine's own argument dispatch owns this first argument (--compile, --repl, --mcp, ...), so a launcher tells its arguments from the CLI's

exports.name: slc_main
exports.summary: the code the process would exit with, from the engine's own dispatch with a JSON array standing in for its command line (no arguments is the REPL)

exports.name: slc_run_bundle
exports.summary: the run's status for a .slcbc: one carrying its program as source runs that source, a source-less one runs its compiled entry

exports.name: slc_call
exports.summary: the call's status for a function the session already has, with the return value in slc_last_result's Result and a JSON array of arguments

exports.name: slc_cancel
exports.summary: 0 the request was made, 2 nothing was running; the one verb callable from another thread while a run is in flight

capabilities.name: output
capabilities.summary: slc_set_output and its line callback, with channel 0 for print and 1 for the engine's log lines

capabilities.name: call
capabilities.summary: slc_call, and Result in the verdict, so a host calls what a run declared

capabilities.name: cancel
capabilities.summary: slc_cancel, the one verb a host may call while a run is in flight

capabilities.name: bundles
capabilities.summary: slc_run_bundle and slc_run_bundle_bytes, the compiled-payload verbs

capabilities.name: main
capabilities.summary: slc_main and slc_main_owns, the executable's own argument dispatch

capabilities.name: async
capabilities.summary: slc_run_text_async, slc_run_file_async and slc_poll, the verbs that return before the run does

capabilities.name: adopt
capabilities.summary: slc_adopt, which registers the host's own object so Com.Host() reaches it

capabilities.name: com
capabilities.summary: the in-proc COM server (ScriptLangCore.Session, DllGetClassObject), which only the Embed configuration compiles: the one build-dependent bit

capabilities.name: sandbox
capabilities.summary: the session honors the "dirs" and "deny" options, so a host can confine a script's paths and forbid the process, network, UI, COM and clipboard families
